question: Does one shared typed structural code-graph reranker improve file localization on whole repositories excluded from development and prior pilots?

dataset.selectionRule: Use all official development rows. On confirmation, order repository candidates by SHA256("ruvector-localization-holdout-v1:" + canonical repository name); within each selected repository choose the row with smallest SHA256(instance_id). Selection reads only pinned dataset metadata, never issue text, patch, tests, model output, or scores.

resourceGate.candidateUniverse: all production Python files under the package prefix declared for the repository; identical universe for every arm
resourceGate.eligibility: Compute from the selected base commit before reading labels or running any scorer. Skip an ineligible repository in the frozen order and continue. Require at least three eligible independent repositories; otherwise record incomplete and do not relax caps.

arms.bm25: k1=1.5, b=0.75 over the frozen candidate chunks
arms.swerank: Salesforce/SweRankEmbed-Small at 745d2a06103a66d3cfa600aa52fc0d3523010daa; max 512 tokens; CC BY NC 4.0 research comparator
arms.graph: One low-capacity pairwise ridge scorer; six typed relation-distance features from import/call/inheritance edges at one and two hops plus reciprocal BM25 and SWERank file ranks. Training labels are development only. Graphs are built from pinned source snapshots as text; repository code is never executed. This is a benchmark sidecar, not native @ruvector/kge integration.

training.rows: all 23 official dev instances; group by repository
training.validation: leave-one-development-repository-out over L2 in [0.01, 0.1, 1, 10]; choose maximum macro MRR, tie to smaller L2
training.final: fit one model on all 23 development instances using selected L2; freeze source, weights, and hashes before confirmation labels are opened
training.confirmation: one pass only; no target-repository labels, adaptation, threshold tuning, or model selection

acceptance.gate: At least 10% relative macro MRR gain over the best retrieval-only arm, positive paired MRR delta in at least two of three held-out repositories, and no Recall@10 regression.
acceptance.interpretation: Three repositories are development evidence only. A pass does not authorize production promotion or a broad state-of-the-art/transfer claim.

integrity.denseRuntimeCap: two Torch CPU threads and at most two CPU hours
